proposals.evidence: Turner’s kīṭa insect family includes Punjabi/Hindi/Gujarati kīṛī ant, beside kīṛā/kīṛo insect. Gujari kīṛo ant matches the same stem with a masculine ending and the documented narrower insect sense; this does not force a morphological analysis of the longer Bhili kiḍāvi forms.
